description: Search active camper listings on VanAuto (vanauto.pl). Use segment "sale" for campers for sale and "rental" for camper rentals. Returns compact rows with price, specs, city and a link to the listing page. All listing text is in Polish. Prices are in PLN; for rentals, priceMin/priceMax filter the daily/per-period rental rate.

after.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call (nextCursor) to fetch the next page.

availableFrom.description: Rental only: earliest pickup date (ISO, e.g. 2026-07-01).

availableTo.description: Rental only: latest return date (ISO, e.g. 2026-07-14).

city.description: City name in Polish, e.g. "Wrocław", "Kraków". Matched against the city catalog.

make.description: Camper make, e.g. "Adria", "Fiat", "Benimar". Use list_camper_makes to resolve names.

priceMax.description: Maximum price in PLN (sale price, or rental rate per period).

priceMin.description: Minimum price in PLN (sale price, or rental rate per period).

query.description: Free-text search over the listing title and description.

sort.description: Sort order. Rental supports newest, price_asc, price_desc only.

name: search_campers
title: Search campers
